functions.recoveredRole: Refresh the available-curve list after the user-defined filter changes
functions.behavior: Passes the Add Curve form and a false override value to the shared list-rebuild function. The rebuilt available-curves list then reflects CustomCB.Checked together with the selected-list exclusion, other category filters, and the case-insensitive text filter. The master curve collection and insertion list are unchanged.
functions.evidence: The DFM binds CustomCB.OnClick to address 013cf750 and labels the initially checked control User defined. The recovered handler contains only FUN_013cab80(param_1, 0). FUN_013cab80 uses the checkbox at form offset 0x7b8 to gate three curve registries while it rebuilds AvailableCurvesLB from the master collection.
